title: Optimizing Energy Efficiency and Grid Stability via Public EV Charging Flexibility
abstract: arXiv:2608.18126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study evaluates the potential of electric vehicle (EV) charging flexibility to enhance both energy efficiency and power grid stability. Using real-world data from public charging stations in Prague, we analyze individual and aggregated charging sessions to explore how optimizing charging times can reduce energy waste, minimize grid imbalances, and support the integration of renewable energy. By aligning EV charging with periods of lower grid demand and higher renewable generation, we demonstrate a significant improvement in energy efficiency, reduc ing the need for costly system support and ancillary services. Our findings suggest that cooperation between power distributors and transmission system operators can unlock new opportunities for maintaining grid stability while promoting sustainable energy use in an increasingly uncertain energy landscape.

translated_title: 通过公共电动汽车充电灵活性优化能源效率与电网稳定性
translated_abstract: 本研究评估了电动汽车（EV）充电灵活性在提升能源效率和电网稳定性方面的潜力。利用布拉格公共充电站的真实数据，我们分析了单个和聚合的充电会话，探讨如何通过优化充电时间减少能源浪费、最小化电网不平衡，并支持可再生能源的整合。通过将EV充电与电网低需求期和高可再生能源发电期对齐，我们展示了能源效率的显著提升，减少了对昂贵的系统支持和辅助服务的需求。我们的研究结果表明，电力分销商与输电系统运营商之间的合作可以解锁新机遇，在日益不确定的能源环境中维护电网稳定性，同时促进可持续能源使用。
tldr: 本研究利用布拉格公共充电站数据，证明通过优化电动汽车充电时间可显著提升能源效率并增强电网稳定性，且强调电力分销商与输电系统运营商合作的重要性。
en_tdlr: This study uses Prague public charging data to show that optimizing EV charging times significantly improves energy efficiency and grid stability, highlighting the importance of cooperation between power distributors and transmission operators.
